technology_name: CNN BASED METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR REAL-TIME OBJECT DETECTION WITH FEATURE REUSE AND CSPNET TO REDUCE COMPUTATIONS
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
technology_type: Computer Vision Optimization / Embedded System Hardware
problem_solved: Running highly detailed real-time object tracking neural networks on edge embedded boards triggers high processor throttling and excessive battery draw.

applications: Autonomous vehicle real-time guidance units, hand-held mobile augmented reality tracking, smart city security camera analytics, and battery-powered portable field monitors.
